اعتملوا (form VIII)
# اِعْتَمَلُوا (iʕtamalū) /iʕ.ta.ma.luː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
# اِعْتَمِلُوا (iʕtamilū) /iʕ.ta.mi.luː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِعْتَمَلَ (iʕtamala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
